UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : U.P. Co-Operative Institutional Service Board (UPCISB) has released the admit card for the Post of Manger, Junior Manager, Assistant/ Cashier (Banking Assistant/Clerical Staff), Assistant/Typist & Assistant Engineer (Civil) in Combined Co-operative Banking and Technical Services Posts. This recruitment was released for 116 posts. Applications for the UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 25 March 2026 to 15 April 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 07 & 08 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Admit Card 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 March 2026
  • Last Date : 15 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 April 2026
  • Exam Date : 07 & 08 September 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 05 September 2026

Application Fee

  • OBC : Rs. 500/- (For UP Candidates)
  • SC Candidates : Rs. 250/- (For UP Candidates)
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 00/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
